# FutbolUAgency (FUA)

> FutbolUAgency LLC is a recruitment agency that helps international football (soccer) players earn athletic scholarships at NCAA, NAIA and NJCAA universities in the United States, and runs a full-season programme with clubs in Spain and Portugal in partnership with Prime Play. Founded in 2020 by former players. The site is available in Spanish (default), English, Italian and German.

Key facts:
- 350+ athletes placed at U.S. universities; over $10M in scholarships secured.
- Rated 5.0 on Google from 100 reviews.
- Free, no-obligation profile evaluation.
- FUA Showcase Talavera 2027: February 1–3, 2027 in Talavera de la Reina (Toledo, Spain), 60 players from Spain and the U.S. in front of U.S. college coaches. By invitation only.
- Contact: futboluagency@gmail.com · +34 603 331 990 (Spain) · +57 333 706 4037 (Latin America).

## Main pages (English)

- [Home](https://futboluagency.com/en): soccer scholarships in the USA, how FUA works.
- [College soccer in the USA](https://futboluagency.com/en/usa): NCAA, NAIA and JUCO, the process, student-athlete life and university network.
- [A season in Spanish football](https://futboluagency.com/en/spain): full season at clubs such as CF Talavera, CE Sabadell, Sport Extremadura and OS Marialvas; ages 16 to 23.
- [Showcase Talavera 2027](https://futboluagency.com/en/showcase): dates, venue, schedule and registration.
- [Our players](https://futboluagency.com/en/players): players already competing at U.S. universities.
- [About us](https://futboluagency.com/en/about): founders and team.
- [Free evaluation](https://futboluagency.com/en/apply): admissions form.
